scope: Complete native SpO2 ratio peak-grid/history dependency chain in C
acceptance_target: Hardware-first license-free C firmware; byte identity waived
contract: Ten native entries are implemented in one C unit, with no inline assembly, executable arrays or new writable state. The root accepts the initialized aggregate and iteration, retains an unused descriptor parameter matching the source caller, and returns0. Its uint32 shared header replaces the caller void declaration; the normal caller object is unchanged.

The root selects the last125 primary-ratio samples, configuration{36,2,1}, temporary index capacity20 and the two native12-byte histories at context+28. The real descriptor/aggregate constructors establish20-entry histories; the tested cadence starts after125 samples and advances every25 samples.

The grid uses actual multiply-by+/-1 and VCMPE-equivalent FPSCR effects. Unsigned HI conditions include unordered comparisons. Multiply the right operand after the first comparison even when that comparison exits; a targeted signaling-NaN control proves the otherwise lost IOC flag. Plateau propagation follows the native left-equality, right-order and row-mask conditions, preserving short-circuit behavior and final FP state.

Ranking counts zero bits and uses the first signed maximum, with the native first-label/row offset. Collapsing writes1 for blocked columns but leaves other destination bytes unchanged. Index collection preserves the last capacity indices after saturation; live counter/index aliases are tested.

Word-window push preserves live count/capacity/buffer reloads across writes and overlap-safe shifting. History insertion compares every candidate against the single old last-entry threshold loaded before the loop. The emitted count resets each call. Full-window shifts adjust the cursor; cutoff scanning stores it only when a qualifying entry is found. If every stored entry is older than the cutoff, the pre-scan cursor remains stored, matching stock.

Actual source-owned heap, memmove and clear helpers execute throughout. The ratio graph performs seven allocation/free pairs; there are no synthetic algorithm boundaries. Source-only probe and stream ELFs have no stock mapping. The older bool/scratch-buffer portable primitives remain distinct APIs, not alternate native owners.
limits: 9334 routine scenario pairs comprise5524 differential cases,3464 independent-oracle cases,325 smoke cases,13 positive defect controls and8 coverage cases. Independent checks include finite grid/plateau constraints, sentinel preservation, first-maximum ranking, deque history semantics,144 alternate first-label cases and256 complete ratio-graph oracles. Thirteen compiled deviations are rejected.

All1304 instruction bytes across the ten native bodies execute. The final two-byte clamp is exercised by a one-sample grid after the main coverage run. Full public RAM, FPSCR, saved R4-R11/S16-S31, SP and masks match. Scalar returns are compared for the ratio/rank interfaces; caller-clobbered registers and private stack contents are outside the proof.

68 actual descriptor/aggregate-constructor streams cover all32 tested rounding/FZ/DN/status settings,12/25 consecutive ratio windows, dropout/recovery and saturation of the native20-entry histories. They compare868 ratio windows and28500 float pushes. Ten final normal-product streams at four representative FP seeds compare146 more ratio windows and4650 pushes. Total routine/window pairs are10348; rolling-push pairs are33150, reported separately.

916 R1 units compile and compose without failures or duplicate strong symbols. Application imports fall86 to85; boot imports remain22.904 prior source/object pairs and the typed caller object remain unchanged. Production/probe executable sections, relocations and symbol contracts match except nonallocated source-file name metadata. Source-plan/cache layout are unchanged.

Valid observed geometry and bounded related dimensions/aliases are covered. Ranking requires a positive score-array length and valid first-label range; index/history capacities are nonzero. Malformed pointers/dimensions, allocation exhaustion, enabled traps, cold FPU, IRQ/concurrency, physical stack/throughput/timing, sensor transport, final startup/layout and boot remain unverified. The stream probe feeds the real rolling queue directly; optical ADC/batch conversion is outside that probe. Eight later SpO2 stages remain unresolved. Relocatable composition is not bootable firmware; no paid compiler or byte identity is required.

Rolling-push totals count paired native/source invocations. Full RAM/FPSCR snapshots are compared at constructor and ratio-window boundaries; saved registers and SP are checked after every call. Push invocations are not counted as additional full-state snapshot comparisons.
